interfaces.name: placeholder_envelope
interfaces.what: THE PLACEHOLDER'S OWN ENVELOPE — measured, and labelled as what it is. Pollen's speaker.stl is 12 triangles: a featureless box x 0.0000..35.0000, y -25.0000..0.0000, z 0.0000..7.0000 = 35.0000 x 25.0000 x 7.0000 mm. The frame origin is the box centre in x and y on its z = 0 face. The MJCF places it in body jaw_soft at world (-17.9226, -16.7860, 245.6146) mm, quat (wxyz) (0.707107, 0, 0, 0.707107) — geom #18, its own pos (0.01, -0.016786, 0.0260226) m and quat (0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5) composed with the body frame. THIS ROW DOES NOT SAY WHAT THE SPEAKER IS. It says what volume the head must clear for whatever is fitted, which is the one thing the reference does state. The 'mount_face' and 'lead' rows below refuse, by name, everything this box cannot answer, and they stand.
interfaces.source: MEASURED off Pollen's speaker.stl (all 12 triangles) and the MJCF geom placement, frozen 2026-09-02 by tools/measure_mesh_features.py into out/laneT/features/speaker.json (lane T)

interfaces.name: mount_face
interfaces.why: the face that seats against the head's motor_support / shell. Pollen's placeholder is a featureless 35 x 25 x 7 box (docs/PARTS.md row 38) with no mounting feature, and the fitted speaker is unidentified (electrical.part.json unknowns), so no frame, no fastener pattern and no sound-port side has been measured. A named refusal, not an empty list.

interfaces.name: lead
interfaces.why: the two-wire lead exit and its 1.25 mm-pitch 2-pin connector on the REPRESENTATIVE ('GH1.25' per ABRA; '1.25-2P' per thingbits) — a stated connector family, no drawing fetched, and nothing known about the fitted part's lead.
